observations: The page number «99» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature «13*» on the right. L01 completes the sentence that ends p. 98 (JP2 0130, L41), «Zu diesen drei Aspekten kommen».

L27 and L32: the formulas, displayed and centred, the fractions built up, written {fr:NUMERATOR|DENOMINATOR}, the root sign over «R ·» and the fraction written {rt:…}; «crd.2», the 2 raised; x, R, b, a, c and the letters of the figure in italics, «crd.» and «cos» upright, «·» the raised dot of multiplication; the comma after the first formula set apart.

A figure stands at the right of L32-L35, which are set in a narrower measure at its left; it is not reproduced. A right spherical triangle: B at the left, A at the upper right and C below A; the arc from B to A, marked 60°, the short side from A down to C, marked b, and the arc from B to C, marked x, below it; the right angle at C. The letters are italic.

L26-L35 and N06. Checked: in the triangle ABC with the right angle at C, the hypotenuse AB = 60° and the sides AC = b and BC = x, the relation cos c = cos a · cos b reads cos 60° = cos x · cos b, whence cos x = cos 60° : cos b. With the chord crd θ = 2R sin (θ/2), crd² θ = 2R² (1 − cos θ), so that crd² 60° − crd² b = 2R² (cos b − cos 60°) and crd² x = 2R² (cos b − cos 60°) : cos b; with «cos b» taken as the cosine in the circle of radius R, R cos b, this is the formula of L27. Nallino (I, 307-308) carries out the same reduction; on I, 307 he reports al-Battānī's rule: the square of the chord of the latitude taken from 3600, the remainder divided and its square root taken.

N03-N05. Checked against Nallino: I, 307-313 is his note on the computation of the projection of the rays, «Supputatio proiectionis radiorum», with the section «De proiectione radiorum ante al-Battānī» (I, 309), which names al-Qabīṣī, Ibn Hibintā and Dorotheus; I, 311 cites the «Liber Quadripartiti».

L03: «26 Seiten», the two pages of the text (pp. 30-31) and the Tables 91-114; to be compared with the tables. L09: Nallino (I, 312) names the same place, «in XXXI Problemate Tabularum directionum profectionumque».

L22: «Rectascention»; see the critical note. L08: the o of «astrologischen» faintly printed; L34: the l of «Formel» damaged, so that it looks like «]»; read as printed words. L17: «ʿEzrā», the ʿ a raised turned comma before the E, the z with a small stroke at its upper left, the ā with its macron; «b.» not spaced. L06: a dot above the comma after «war»; not transcribed.

The dashes: L23 «genannten. — Ptol.» and L25 «Planeten. — Der» (44 and 47 px), long dashes with a space on either side; L27 the minus of the formula, a long dash (44 px); N03 «307—313» and N06 «307—308» (35 and 34 px, the small type), set close. L22: «±», the plus sign over a stroke.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Kh.», «Batt.», «Al-Ḳabīṣī», «Alcabitius», «Abraham», «ʿEzrā», «Dorotheus», «Ibn Hibintā», «Ptol.», «Nallino»; italics: «Konjunktion», «Opposition», «Gegenschein», «Regiomontanus», «Ortes», «Strahlenwerfung», «radiatio», «Quadripartitum», the letters of the formulas, «ABC», «Tabulae directionum profectionumque».
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (8-13 px measured).
